data.one_liner: Image handling library with extended features like caching, zoom, editor, and placeholder support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of image widgets that support placeholder and error states, network caching, zoom and pan, photo editing (crop, rotate, flip), and custom painting. It also includes web support via WASM and a WebHtmlElementStrategy for network images.
use_when: Need advanced image features such as zoom, pan, or editing
Require caching and placeholder handling for network images
Building a photo gallery or editor app
avoid_when: You only need basic image display or simple caching
You prefer a minimal dependency footprint
strengths: Rich feature set (zoom, pan, editor, caching)
weaknesses: Large package size due to many features
Requires Flutter SDK 3.16+ for latest versions
Limited documentation on some advanced features

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler caching for network images without editor or zoom features

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides zoom and pan for images but without caching or editor
